latestVersion.changelog:
Auto Shorts v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Convert long-form videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into vertical short clips for platforms like TikTok and Reels.
- Automatic cloud-based setup and processing; no manual authentication needed for first-time users.
- Supports uploading files or providing video URLs, with results in 1–2 minutes as 1080p MP4s.
- Handles credits, export, and session state with clear user guidance and error messaging.
- User prompts intelligently routed to upload, generation, export, credits, or status actions.
- Includes tips for best results and troubleshooting common issues (file size/format, missing credits).
